star_rating.name: Tourist
star_rating.description: Properties that offer budget facilities without compromising cleanliness or guest security. Guests may access fee-based services or facilities upon request.

star_rating.name: Standard
star_rating.description: Properties that focus on the needs of price conscious travellers. Services and guest facilities are typically limited to keep room rates affordable and competitive but may be available upon request or fee-based.

star_rating.name: Comfort
star_rating.description: Properties that deliver a broad range of amenities that exceed above-average accommodation needs. Good quality service, design and physical attributes are typically fit for purpose to match guest expectations.

star_rating.name: First_class
star_rating.description: Properties which achieve a deluxe guest experience. A wide range of facilities and superior design qualities are typically complemented by service standards that reflect the varied and discerning needs of the guest.

star_rating.name: Luxury
star_rating.description: Properties that typify luxury across all areas of operation. Guests will enjoy an extensive range of facilities and comprehensive or highly personalised services. Properties at this level will display excellent design quality and attention to detail.

hotel.name: Hilton_Sofia
hotel.description:
Opposite the National Palace of Culture and within 10 minutes on foot from the very heart of the city, Hilton Sofia is surrounded by the South Park and overlooks Vitosha Mountain.
The Art Deco-style rooms feature satellite flat-screen TV, bathrobes and tea/coffee makers. They are equipped with comfortable Hilton Serenity beds and ergonomic desk chairs. The spacious bathrooms come with a walk-in shower, bathtub and free toiletries.

hotel.name: Plovdiv_City_Center_Hotel
hotel.description: Featuring a bar, terrace and views of city, Plovdiv City Center Hotel is located in Plovdiv, 200 m from Roman Theatre Plovdiv. The property is set 2.8 km from Plovdiv Plaza, 300 m from Plovdiv Municipality and 600 m from Ethnographic Museum Plovdiv. The accommodation provides room service and luggage storage for guests.

hotel.name: Marina_Burgas_Hotel
hotel.description:
Marina Burgas Hotel is situated on the beachfront in Burgas City, 1.4 km from North Beach Burgas and 5 km from Burgas Saltworks. Among the facilities of this property are a restaurant, a 24-hour front desk and a concierge service, along with free WiFi. The property is allergy-free and is set 10 km from Museum of Aviation.
The hotel will provide guests with air-conditioned rooms with a desk, a safety deposit box, a flat-screen TV and a private bathroom with a shower. At Marina Burgas Hotel the rooms have bed linen and towels.

hotel.name: Hotel_and_Casino_Cherno_More
hotel.description: The Hotel and Casino Cherno More is located in the centre of Varna and offers air-conditioned rooms with free WiFi and panoramic views. The beach is located 450 m away and the Sea Garden can be reached in 300 m.

hotel.name: Yantra_Grand_Hotel
hotel.description: This 4-star hotel is situated in Veliko Tarnovo, offering views of the Tzarevets Fortress and the historical settlement of Arbanassi. It offersLobby Bar and Vienna Cafe and free private parking. Rooms have free WiFi access. An indoor pool and a fitness centre are provided free of charge.

hotel.name: Impuls_Hotel_and_SPA
hotel.description:
Impuls hotel and SPA features a bar, spa and wellness centre and terrace in Vidin. Among the facilities of this property are a restaurant, a 24-hour front desk and a shared lounge, along with free WiFi throughout the property. Private parking can be arranged at an extra charge.
The hotel will provide guests with air-conditioned rooms with a wardrobe, a kettle, a minibar, a safety deposit box, a flat-screen TV, a balcony and a private bathroom with a shower. At Impuls hotel and SPA each room is equipped with bed linen and towels.

hotel.name: City_Blagoevgrad_Hotel
hotel.description:
City Blagoevgrad Hotel is located peacefully within 1 km of the centre of Blagoevgrad, the local bus station and Southwestern University Neofit Rilski. It offers guests spacious rooms that have a balcony with city views. Free private parking is provided on site.
Rooms at the Blagoevgrad's City Hotel also have air conditioning, a bathroom, refrigerator and cable TV. Аll units have a seating area and Wi-Fi is available free of charge.

hotel.name: Mountain_Lake_Hotel
hotel.description:
High in the Rhodope Mountains, this hotel offers luxury spa facilities less than 1 km from Snezhanka ski lifts. The chalet-style apartment buildings provide free Wi-Fi and panoramic mountain views.
The guest apartments at Mountain Lake Hotel have hardwood floors and white linens, and satellite TV comes as standard. All rooms and apartments feature private bathrooms, and many have an open fireplace.
Hotel Mountain Lake features an elegant restaurant, offering a range of regional specialties and international favourites. There is also a cosy bar where you can relax with a drink.
